entries.summary: On behalf of the Spring AI team and everyone who has contributed, I'm happy to announce that Spring AI 2.1.0 has been released and is now available from Maven Central!
entries.text: On behalf of the Spring AI team and everyone who has contributed, I'm happy to announce that Spring AI 2.1.0 has been released and is now available from Maven Central! Release notes | Upgrade notes | Reference documentation Spring AI 2.1 arrives five months after 2.0.0 GA. It is built on Spring Boot 4.2 and contains more than 430 commits from 86 contributors. This post covers everything that changed since 2.0.0: the features of the 2.1 milestones and release candidates, what was added after RC2, and the additions that already shipped in 2.0.1 and 2.0.2. The short version: MCP 2026-07-28. Servers and clients for the new, stateless revision of the Model Context Protocol, next to the existing ones. Decision Models. A new model API for typed yes/no, choice and score decisions, with three providers. A richer message model. Messages hold ordered parts, so reasoning, tool calls and provider-specific blocks survive a round trip. The OpenAI Responses API is supported next to Chat Completions. The building blocks of an agent harness. The Session API, with session memory, compaction and recall, replaces ChatMemory. Tool calls can wait for a person's approval and are limited per turn, and guardrail refusals are marked as such. Your own embeddings. Eleven vector stores can write and search with vectors you computed yourself. New reference documentation, organized around tasks, with a quickstart and tutorials. Security. Fixes for 13 CVEs, which Spring AI 2.0.3 has as well. Next: Spring AI

entries.summary: On behalf of the community, I am pleased to announce that the General Availability (RELEASE) of the Spring Cloud 2025.1.5 Release Train is available today.
entries.text: On behalf of the community, I am pleased to announce that the General Availability (RELEASE) of the Spring Cloud 2025.1.5 Release Train is available today. The release can be found in Maven Central. You can check out the 2025.1.5 release notes for more information. Notable Changes in the 2025.1.5 Release Train This release is compatible with Spring Boot 4.0.x and 4.1.x. This release contains several bug fixes across all projects. For a complete list of what was fixed in this release see this GitHub project. Spring Cloud Commons Fix resetBeanToDefaults transiently nulling nested @ConfigurationProperties objects, which could cause NullPointerExceptions in concurrent request threads (#1727) Fix config refresh failing and leaving refreshScope DOWN when spring.datasource.connection-fetch=lazy is used (#1778) Fix config refresh failing for a @ConfigurationProperties bean that is proxied twice (#1780) Correct the HealthCheckServiceInstanceListSupplier documentation, which stated that all instances are returned when none are healthy (#1771) Spring Cloud Config Fix for CVE-2026-59435 — Spring Cloud Config Server Leaks Backend Git and SVN Credentials via Property Source Names Fix for CVE-2026-59436 — Git Repos Do Not Validate SSH Host Key When Using SSH In Spring Cloud Config Server Fix for CVE-2026-59437 — Man In The Middle Attack Possible When Using Git and SSH With Spring Cloud Config Server Fix retrieving properties in YAML or JSON format returning manipulated, incorrect property k
